articles.title: CVS Health Reportedly Splitting Into Two Separate Companies
articles.summary: Reports indicate that CVS Health is planning to split its business into two distinct entities, separating its retail and insurance operations from its pharmacy benefit management and healthcare services divisions. This massive structural realignment could significantly shift the competitive landscape for self-funded employer health plans and alter PBM market dynamics.
articles.source_line: Source: Managed Healthcare Executive; Wed, 04 Nov 2026 00:22:40 GMT

articles.title: Biosimilar Pipeline and PBM Formulary Strategy Insights
articles.summary: Managed Healthcare Executive explores the evolving biosimilar pipeline and how pharmacy benefit managers manage formularies to drive adoption. For self-funded employers, effective utilization of biosimilars represents a significant opportunity to curb specialty drug spending and lower net plan costs. Understanding PBM formulary placement strategies helps plan sponsors navigate upcoming patent expirations and market shifts.
articles.source_line: Source: Managed Healthcare Executive; Tue, 03 Nov 2026 13:52:36 GMT

articles.title: Department of Labor Rule Mandates PBM Rebate and Spread Pricing Disclosures for Employers
articles.summary: The Department of Labor has finalized a new rule requiring PBMs to disclose rebates and spread pricing to self-funded employer health plans starting in July 2027. This regulatory shift increases transparency in pharmacy benefit management contracts, enabling plan sponsors to better evaluate true drug costs. The mandate will significantly impact PBM contracting practices and heighten fiduciary compliance requirements for self-funded employers.

articles.title: Drug Costs and GLP-1s Drive Record Employer Health Plan Spikes
articles.summary: Employer-sponsored health plans are experiencing their largest cost increases in decades, driven heavily by rising prescription drug expenditures and the widespread adoption of GLP-1 weight-loss medications. This trend places mounting financial pressure on self-funded employers to reevaluate their pharmacy benefit strategies and cost-containment measures.

articles.title: CVS Health Explores Potential Split of Retail Pharmacy and Insurance Units
articles.summary: CVS Health is reportedly considering a breakup of its retail pharmacy and insurance businesses amid mounting financial and operational pressures. For self-funded employers and PBM competitors, this potential restructuring signals major shifts in the vertically integrated health plan and pharmacy benefits landscape.

articles.title: CVS Surges on Potential Pharmacy Unit Spin-Off Rumors
articles.summary: Reports suggesting a potential spin-off of CVS Health's pharmacy operations drove after-hours stock gains ahead of its Q3 earnings report. Major structural shifts by a dominant vertically integrated player like CVS have significant implications for PBM market dynamics and self-funded employer plan strategies.

articles.title: CVS Considers Splitting Pharmacy and Insurance Units
articles.summary: CVS Health is reportedly weighing a breakup of its massive healthcare empire, which would separate its retail and pharmacy benefit management operations from its insurance business. This potential restructuring could significantly alter the competitive landscape for self-funded employers and PBM market dynamics.
articles.source_line: Source: New York Post; Wed, 04 Nov 2026 00:12:00 GMT

articles.title: Rising PBM Audits and Fraud Investigations Cause Pharmacy Network Disruptions
articles.summary: Pharmacy benefit managers are increasing network audits and fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA) investigations, leading to significant pharmacy network disruptions. This trend impacts network access for self-funded employer plans and highlights ongoing compliance and contract enforcement within pharmacy benefit management.
articles.source_line: Source: Buchanan Ingersoll & Rooney PC; Wed, 04 Nov 2026 00:13:23 GMT

articles.title: CVS Health Evaluates Splitting Retail Pharmacy from PBM and Aetna Units
articles.summary: CVS Health is reportedly considering a corporate spin-off that would separate its retail pharmacy chain from its Caremark PBM and Aetna insurance businesses. This potential restructuring reflects mounting industry pressure on vertically integrated healthcare giants and could reshape the competitive landscape for self-funded employer health plans.
articles.source_line: Source: Insurance Business; Wed, 04 Nov 2026 00:54:18 GMT

articles.title: Final PBM Transparency Rules Empower Self-Funded Plan Sponsors
articles.summary: New transparency regulations for pharmacy benefit managers give self-funded employers unprecedented access to pricing data, contract terms, and rebate details. This shift allows plan sponsors to better audit their PBM contracts, challenge hidden costs, and take greater control over pharmacy benefit spend. The rules increase fiduciary pressure on employers to actively review and optimize their PBM arrangements.

articles.title: CVS Health Weighs Breakup of Integrated Healthcare Conglomerate Model
articles.summary: CVS Health is reportedly considering splitting its massive healthcare conglomerate, potentially separating its pharmacy benefit manager, retail pharmacy, and insurance operations. This structural shakeup could significantly alter the competitive landscape for self-funded employers and reshape how PBM services are contracted and delivered.

articles.title: MedImpact Acquires Rebate Aggregator in PBM Market Consolidation
articles.summary: MedImpact has acquired a rebate aggregator to bolster its pharmacy benefit management capabilities amid ongoing industry evolution. This M&A move highlights how mid-market PBMs are restructuring their drug rebate and supply chain operations to better compete for employer business. For self-funded employers, such structural shifts impact rebate pass-through models and overall net drug cost transparency.
articles.source_line: Source: Insurance Business; Tue, 03 Nov 2026 14:43:24 GMT

articles.title: Teva Secures US Rights for Samsung Bioepis TNF Inhibitor Biosimilars
articles.summary: Teva has licensed the US commercialization rights for Samsung Bioepis's portfolio of TNF inhibitor biosimilars, increasing market competition in the costly inflammatory disease category. This partnership is expected to expand market access and drive down net drug costs for self-funded employer health plans managing high-spend specialty biologics.
articles.source_line: Source: BioPharm International; Tue, 03 Nov 2026 16:28:10 GMT

articles.title: GLP-1 Adherence Critical to Evaluating DTC Value for Employers
articles.summary: As direct-to-consumer channels expand access to GLP-1 medications, maintaining patient adherence has emerged as the critical factor in determining overall clinical and financial value. Self-funded employers offering weight-loss benefits must focus on adherence strategies rather than just access to manage soaring specialty drug costs effectively.
articles.source_line: Source: The American Journal of Managed Care; Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:49:29 GMT
articles.source_name: The American Journal of Managed Care

articles.title: CVS Faces $41 Million Lawsuit Over Alleged 340B Repricing Scheme
articles.summary: A new $41 million lawsuit accuses CVS Health of engaging in an improper 340B drug repricing scheme, increasing legal scrutiny on major PBMs and pharmacies regarding safety-net drug pricing. This litigation highlights ongoing legal and financial risks within the 340B ecosystem that impact supply chain transparency and drug costs.

articles.title: CVS Health Explores Structural Breakup of Retail and Insurance Operations
articles.summary: CVS Health is reportedly testing a separation of its retail pharmacy and insurance units following mounting pressure from investors over financial performance. A potential breakup of the healthcare giant would significantly alter the competitive landscape for PBM services, retail pharmacy networks, and integrated health plan offerings available to self-funded employers.
